title: Orchid Slow-Release Plant Food
description:
How to Use and Dosage

  • Existing Pots: Sprinkle 1 scoop (10ml) on top of the soil in Ø17cm pots and water as usual.
  • Repotting: Repot your plant as normal. 180 days after repotting mix 1 scoop (10ml) into 2L of substrate and mix it through the soil.

Tips

  • Fertilize only while the plant is growing (spring/summer). Pause during fall and winter.
  • Less is more: Never exceed the recommended dosage.
  • No need to dissolve in water—apply directly to the soil.
  • Do not use this fertiliser the first 180 days after repotting with SYBASoil!

Orchid Slow-Release Plant Food

Orchid Slow-Release Plant Food is the easy way to give your orchids consistent care without weekly feeding. Designed as an orchid slow release fertilizer, it delivers essential nutrients gradually over time, keeping your plants nourished for months. Best used with mineral substrates like SYBAStones, especially the Orchid Mineral Mix, this orchid controlled release fertilizer supports healthy roots, stronger stems, and vibrant flowers with minimal effort.

Why Orchids Thrive With Slow-Release Care

Orchids can be sensitive to sudden doses of nutrition. Liquid feeding is effective, but it requires frequent attention. Orchid nutrient pellets provide a steady supply of balanced nutrition that mimics the gentle way orchids absorb food in nature. This method reduces the risk of overfeeding while encouraging continuous flowering and resilient growth. By choosing orchid fertilizer granules instead of harsh alternatives, you give your plants lasting strength and beauty.

Steady Support With Every Application

Orchid Slow-Release Plant Food is designed to release nutrients gradually, so your orchid receives a continuous flow of balanced nutrition. These orchid care pellets work especially well in the SYBAStones Orchid Mineral Mix, where they provide the consistent feeding that a non-organic substrate cannot offer on its own. By using orchid growth pellets instead of quick-dissolving fertilisers, you avoid sudden nutrient spikes and keep your orchid on a stable path to long-term health.

Benefits of Using Slow-Release Nutrition

  • Designed for mineral substrates like SYBAStones Orchid Mineral Mix
  • Improves root strength and prevents nutrient deficiencies
  • Supports lush leaves and longer flowering cycles
  • Reduces the need for frequent fertilizing
  • Safe and gentle, protecting orchids from fertilizer burn

  • Season-adjusting; Automatically feeds more in summer, less in winter

With orchid release nutrition, your plants receive a balanced rhythm of nutrients that supports steady, resilient growth.

Eco-Conscious, Tested, and Trusted

Sybotanica designs every SYBASupport product with sustainability in mind. This orchid long term fertilizer is made with eco-friendly practices and developed to integrate smoothly into modern growing methods. Trusted by orchid lovers across Europe, these orchid fertilizer granules are valued for their reliability, ease of use, and clean approach to care.

With Sybotanica, Orchid Slow-Release Plant Food is the perfect partner for mineral-based orchid setups, giving your collection the consistent support it needs to thrive season after season.
